explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 93 named tracks/releases across Juno's current techno window, Boomkat's September 14 new-release index, adjacent 2026 label catalogues, remastered overlooked material and targeted persistent-state cross-checks. Written attributed descriptions and exact listings only; no audio audition.
exclusions: Jay Mitta — Sawa and Lotic — Carried remain removed after severe listener feedback; Luigi Tozzi — Tender Is The Night remains positively retained. Explicit threat- or panic-coded propositions were deprioritized.
Completed Runs 235, 236, 239, 240 and 241 were compared before ranking. None of the top three proposed boundaries repeats an evaluated boundary from those runs.

Every ranked artist/title pair was checked against canonical state, target-local discovery/rejection/PARKED history and the global utility ledger. Recent unresolved and evaluated identities were excluded, including Section 6 — Infinitas, Active Systems — Maus, COW — Cobra, Oscar Later selections and the Run 241 Coki selections.

The nine ranked identities are exact-title leads with individual descriptions or explicitly bounded evidence limits. Same-release leads are differentiated by track-specific prose; no artist, texture, novelty, genre or boundary-diversity quota is applied.
No proposed placement splits Transparency → When We Froze → Stardancer. The Miniteca Selvatica placement tests only the unprotected entry into the trio.

Run 242 was REQUEST_NOT_COMPLETED before identity resolution. Exact resolver error: "Lead 9 placement 1 must reference current canonical ledger URIs". This recovery uses a new runId, cites failed request commit ba7b9705f40016f87f97e92a13ff755c268081a2, preserves the scan, and derives the corrected Lead 9 pair from the current ledger.
